description: Project the cumulative cost of a fee list over 1-30 years by straight multiplication of each recurring fee's annualized amount, with one-time fees counted once (no compounding or inflation), with a per-fee breakdown. Use for 'what will these cost me over N years'. It does not flag fees: use audit_fees to find problem charges, benchmark_fees for typical ranges.

fees.description: Non-empty list of fees to project, each {name, amount, frequency, category?}; category is accepted but not used here

amount.description: Amount per charge in USD, greater than 0, e.g. 38 or 15.99 (for monthly fees, the monthly amount)

category.description: Optional benchmark category key (case-insensitive; spaces/hyphens become underscores). One of: bank_overdraft, bank_monthly_maintenance, atm_out_of_network, late_payment, gym_membership_monthly, streaming_monthly, airline_checked_bag, airline_seat_fee, ticket_convenience, rental_application, subscription_app_monthly, delivery_fee, airline_change_fee, hotel_resort_fee. Unknown keys are ignored for benchmarking and listed in audit_fees' note.

frequency.description: How often the fee is charged: 'monthly' (x12 per year), 'annual' or 'one-time'

name.description: Fee label as it appears on the statement, e.g. 'Overdraft fee' or 'Netflix'

years.description: Number of years to project, integer 1-30; default 1

name: annual_cost

cumulative_total.description: Sum of all per-fee cumulative amounts, USD

note.description: Method note: recurring fees multiplied by years, one-time fees counted once, no compounding

annualized.description: Yearly cost of this fee, USD (monthly x12; annual as-is; one-time = the single charge, counted once)

cumulative.description: Total over the period, USD: annualized x years for monthly/annual fees; the single amount for one-time fees

title: Annual cost
